title: Errors
description: The error codes of decision 0012, the one table every reader takes them from (cleanup item 11.1): apischema.py, gen_api_md.py (docs/API.md's table), web/tools/gen-api.ts (ERROR_CODES), the contract suite's client, and tests/unit/engine/test_api_tables.cpp, which holds the engine's codes (engine/rpc.h, toRpc) to it. Every error reply carries its errc in data.errc. A row with `protocol` is JSON-RPC's own: no method's `errors` lists it. parse_error has two codes: the protocol's for a line that is not JSON, the core's for a file or bytes that are no puzzle.

errors.meaning: not a JSON-RPC request (batches are refused)
a parameter is missing, of the wrong type, or unknown
a value out of range or malformed
no such shape, color, problem, solution or handle
a file or bytes that are no puzzle
reading or writing a file failed
valid, but not for this puzzle (what a grid or a solver lacks: a take-apart, an assembler, Panex columns)
not now: pause the solve first, close the edit group...
a broken invariant in the engine or the core
